senses.gloss: m.(b. h. חֹרֶשׁ, v. Ges. H. Dict. s. v. חרש II, cmp. חֵרֵשׁ) [difficult of accession,] thicket, wild-growing bushes.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 1:2:8">Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39ᶜ</cite> <he>ונעשה ח׳ גדול</he> and it grew to a large thicket of reeds; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:6">Cant. R. to I, 6</cite>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 29:10">Lev. R. s. 29</cite> <he>ניתש מח׳ זה וכ׳</he> tears himself loose from one thicket and is caught in another; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 2:4:3">Y. Taan. II, 65ᵈ</cite> top; Pesik. Baḥod., p. 154ᵇ <he>חדש</he> (corr. acc.), v. <cite ref="N00589"><he>נָטַשׁ</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 645">Yalk. Lev. 645</cite>.—Pl. <he>חוֹרָשִׁים</he>, <he>חוֹרָשִׁין</he>, <he>חֳרָשִׁים</he>.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 81a:1">B. Kam. 81ᵃ</cite> top <he>שהיו מרעין בח׳</he> that people shall have the privilege of pasture on untilled lands.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:19">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵃ</cite> top, v. <cite ref="B00162"><he>בָּהָה</he></cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 4:2:7">Y. Shebi. IV, 35ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>בחד׳</he> (corr. acc.).
